visual_description: A compact, suitcase-style gasoline generator. The casing is a professional matte red or blue plastic with a comfortable carry handle. It features a digital display showing 'Wattage Output' and several protected AC outlets. It is tucked behind a small rock outcrop to further dampen sound.

constraints.detail: Visible exhaust port and fuel cap; looks ruggedized for dust/sand resistance.
constraints.background: Sitting on a rubber mat to prevent vibration into the bone bed.
